name: Gasthof Pension Neuwirt
beschreibung: The Gasthof Pension Neuwirt is a traditional hotel in Tirol, Österreich. The accommodation is located in a quiet rural area with a view of the Tiroler Alpen. The atmosphere is characterized by Tyrolean hospitality and cozy furnishings. Guests can use comfortably furnished rooms and a breakfast buffet. The surrounding area is suitable for hiking and winter sports. The amenities include a restaurant with regional dishes and parking facilities. The guesthouse serves as a base for excursions into the surrounding mountains.
